desc:
NEW CODE at 50,000 LIKES! All current codes in community server

🔥 Welcome to Cooking Chaos 🔥

Jump into the kitchen with up to 3 friends and race to serve as many orders as possible before the timer runs out! But wait, there's more...

🚀 Unlock perks to boost yourself and friends in the kitchen
🎲 Roll for classes to help unlock your true chef potential
⚡ Upgrade your appliances to cook, chop and prepare dishes even faster

⭐Gain stars on courses and maps to unlock new recipes

🎮 Controls - PC/Console:
Interact/pickup/drop - E || X/Square
Throw - Q || Y/Triangle
Use Item - M1 || R2/RT
Activate perk - 1,2,3,4 || L3,R3,L1,R1
